review_sequence.purpose: Review copy, evidence labels, exclusions and route composition inside ChatGPT before formal prepublish review.
Freeze accepted candidate and complete claim-source, restricted-content, entity/legal and status-truth checks.

Public status may be asserted only after exact artifact + target/action + provider readback.

candidate_copy.headline: About Römer Industries
candidate_copy.body: Römer Industries develops and coordinates a portfolio of research, digital systems and infrastructure concepts using an evidence-governed workflow. Current work includes digital-twin and data architecture, infrastructure and facility concepts, advanced-material and energy research, and long-horizon space-systems studies. Public materials distinguish source-backed digital design and tested software from externally validated physical capability.
candidate_copy.guardrail: Development-stage portfolio. No government approval, certified engineering/performance, partner status or definitive corporate/IP relationship is implied unless separately evidenced.

candidate_copy.headline: Evidence Before Promotion
candidate_copy.body: Each programme is tracked by source, revision, evidence class and discipline maturity. Digital equations, simulations and 3D/reference geometry may be published when independently checked and clearly labelled; they do not become manufacturing, certification or empirical-performance proof without the corresponding external evidence.
candidate_copy.guardrail: Unresolved evidence remains visible and claim scope is reduced rather than filled by assumption.

candidate_copy.headline: A Portfolio Built in Stages
candidate_copy.body: The public-safe portfolio is organised by maturity rather than a single pass/fail label: source recovery, geometry and interface mapping, parametric modelling, digital execution, independent proof, fabrication-readiness subject to external gates, and empirical validation. This lets mature digital work be reviewed without overstating physical readiness.
candidate_copy.guardrail: Programme-specific evidence and restrictions govern every claim.

candidate_copy.headline: M1 / SEQLD Living Infrastructure Study
candidate_copy.body: M1 / SEQLD is a digital infrastructure study of modular elevated-corridor geometry, transfer logic and living-infrastructure interfaces. The current publishable state includes source-extracted and parametric geometry, governed edge-envelope equations and labelled 3D/reference views. Current CAD regeneration, physical structural adequacy, approvals, construction and performance remain open evidence lanes.
candidate_copy.guardrail: Concept/digital-study status only; no TMR approval, certified design, procurement, construction or operational-performance claim.

candidate_copy.headline: InterSol Platform
candidate_copy.body: InterSol is a proposed multidisciplinary facility/platform concept used to organise digital-twin, research, operations and specialist-review workflows. Its current public-safe material focuses on function, interfaces, source geometry and evidence acquisition rather than site, partner, approval or construction claims.
candidate_copy.guardrail: Proposed/conceptual platform; no confirmed site, partner, approval, procurement or construction status is implied.

candidate_copy.headline: Watch Tower Digital Reference
candidate_copy.body: The Watch Tower public-safe twin is grounded in source-locked owner CAD and separates source-extracted geometry from parametric secondary views and future engineering decisions. The 3D display can expose object/interface relationships and evidence state while structural ratings, cable design, site applicability and physical qualification remain gated.
candidate_copy.guardrail: Digital/source geometry is not a certified structural or construction model; restricted or security-sensitive details are excluded.
